definitions.explanation: The angular distance of a place east or west of the prime meridian, measured in degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東経|とうけい}→東経：noentry⟧139⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}している→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧。
examples.english: Tokyo is located at 139 degrees east longitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦GPS→GPS：08842_jiipiiesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{経度|けいど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緯度|いど}→緯度：03978_ido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I checked the longitude and latitude with GPS.

examples.japanese: {経度|けいど}0⟦{度|ど}→度：09845_do⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本初|ほんしょ}子午線→本初子午線：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The line at 0 degrees longitude is called the prime meridian.

notes:
GEOGRAPHY:
・{東経|とうけい} (east longitude)
・{西経|せいけい} (west longitude)
・{経度|けいど}0{度|ど} (0 degrees longitude - prime meridian)
・{本初|ほんしょ}子午線 (prime meridian - Greenwich)

PAIR WORD:
・{緯度|いど} (latitude)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{経度|けいど}と{緯度|いど} (longitude and latitude)
・{経緯|けいい} (longitude and latitude - abbreviated form; also means 'circumstances')

HISTORY: The measurement of longitude was a significant challenge in navigation history. Japan adopted the international standard with the prime meridian at Greenwich in 1886.

NOTE: Japan spans from approximately 122°E to 154°E longitude.
